description.en: The 0% marginal rate on the lowest band of France's progressive personal income tax (Impôt sur le Revenu, IRPP). Used as Band_Rate both in tin_fr's SchedCalc to compute the "Gross income tax (before any IMAX corrections)" and again in tinkt_fr's SchedCalc to recompute tax under the reduced/floor quotient familial as part of the family-ratio-capping (Imax) mechanism. Matches the 0% bracket up to the $tin_upthres1 ceiling shown in the theme doc's and country report's IRPP rate tables.

explanation.en: EUROMOD function group: Paramteres of the income tax
